expected_rate: every Track A FADE trigger while the fade record is below the stop rule (all of them on the current record, about 1-3 per trading day); zero non-FADE skips
reversal: a non-FADE Day entry (RIDE, PULLBACK, DRIVE) is skipped by this rule, a Track A FADE entry fills while the fade record fails the rule, or the skipped FADEs logged over the next 20 would have made money at the same size

metrics.name: fade_entries_filled
metrics.source: logs/day_tier_events.jsonl entry_fill rows whose decision trigger.mode is FADE (Track A)

metrics.name: non_fade_entries
metrics.source: logs/day_tier_events.jsonl entry_fill rows with mode RIDE/PULLBACK/DRIVE
metrics.bound: unchanged by this rule (no day-align-1123 skip on them)
